note: test_malloc N starts ten anonymous processes at KKERN_PRIORITY_MEDIUM_03 - above the console - that fill, check and free the heap forever. Nothing can stop them (kill works on module names), so the stress run itself is NOT a row: it would leave the board unusable until a reset, and on Discovery_N657, the one board that builds it, SWD cannot reset a board that is not faulted. Only the paths that must start nothing are here. Never pass 0, a non-number or a count whose N*4 wraps: those allocate and START the test.

tests.note: 400 MB of pointers cannot be allocated on any board, so the first reservation fails and nothing may be started
